Independent characteristic-7 SymPy verified F^5/F^3 coefficients, rank-one discriminant reduction and special discriminant values; source exhaustive F7 and sampled F49 semilinear matrix iteration checked formula. Algebraic case-splitting on P=aE=W yields the complete rank0/rank1 loci, not extrapolated from finite tests.
residual_risks: The algebraic formula is for coefficient-marked smooth curves, not isomorphism classes or Newton polygons.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete Cartier-rank and a-number stratification of a three-parameter genus-six family, including geometric identification of rank-zero and rank-one moduli-parameter loci. Both generic and deep rank degeneracies are characterized.
residual_risks: Coefficient-marked classification is narrower than classification by geometric isomorphism; no Newton polygons or EO strata claimed.

final_claim: For every smooth curve y⁴=x⁵+ax³+bx+c over algebraic closure F7, the explicit Cartier coefficients P,E,W determine rank 2[ P≠0 ]+2/1/0 according to (aE,W), all ranks0..4 occur, ranks5,6 do not; rank-zero locus is a=b=0,c≠0 and rank-one locus two parametrized punctured monomial cusps. The a-number has the claimed explicit formula and only values2,3,4.
